palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward.

Here's an example of a palindrome that is longer than 255 characters:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam"

To make it at least 255 characters long, you can repeat this phrase several times:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam Madam Arora teaches malayalam Madam Arora teaches malayalam..."

Just keep in mind that if the original palindrome is too short to reach the desired length when repeated multiple times, it might be necessary to find a longer initial palindrome or modify the structure of the repeating phrase.
